draft.text: You came in to talk about the numbness on the side of your knee where you had surgery.
The numbness has not changed since your surgery and is not causing any problems with your daily activities or physical therapy.
The numbness is likely due to the surgery and is localized to the area of your incision.
The next steps will be discussed during your next visit.
